title: Update example url on connectHierarchicalMenu document
body:
**Summary**

I found the example link at [](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html)
And github return 404 not found,
then I find the example at git repository and its available at

https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/dev/app/custom-widgets/jquery/hierarchicalMenu.js

**Result**

Update url from (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/feat/instantsearch.js/v2/dev/app/custom-widgets/jquery/hierarchicalMenu.js)

to (https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/dev/app/custom-widgets/jquery/hierarchicalMenu.js)

User will can see the example immediately when click example link
